lesson_ratings.title: جمال المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Rich vocabulary about nature, dreams, and ocean life with varied sentence structures.

lesson_ratings.title: السمك الفرحان جوة المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces fish, emotions, and contrasting situations with useful everyday phrases.

lesson_ratings.title: متعة وأمان جوة المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Teaches expressions about safety and impossibility, though some lines are repetitive.

lesson_ratings.title: الرقص جوة المحيط
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces sea creatures and dance-related vocabulary, but chorus repeats earlier themes.

lesson_ratings.title: الأوركسترا الكبير
lesson_ratings.reason: New vocabulary about orchestra and shells, but limited distinct content.

phrases.text: Algae is always sweeter in the neighbors' lake
If you dream to go to them, you are, my love, mistaken
If you look at the sweet world here inside the ocean
You will find it play and song and more than you want
Inside the ocean
Inside the ocean
Water freshness and ultimate sweetness under the ocean
On the surface hardship all day, the sun heat, no choice
And we swim so we stand inside the ocean
Here the fish is happy and in the waves lives safely
And outside the fish is angry and in the tank trapped sad
And the tank fish is lucky, in others their nerves get ruined
If the boss was hungry he would eat him with the mayonnaise
Here it is inside the ocean
Inside the ocean
Who will grill or fry? No, this is impossible
On land they want to eat us, here like our length
Inside the bubble ultimate fun inside the ocean
Inside the ocean
Life is sweet, they love the song, this is natural
Even the flounder and the stingray comes to dance without two legs
We are its joy, we will live in its safety inside the ocean
Inside the ocean
Inside the ocean
When the sardine gets up and dances and souls too
What do they have? Sand a lot. We are here a big orchestra
The scallop never gets dirty inside the ocean
The stories and the parties inside the ocean
All the wonderful shells, soft life here in the water
Here the ocean, inside the ocean
